## Description
<!--- Provide a general summary of your change in the Pull Request title above -->
<!--- Describe your change in detail here. -->
The fix was simple, window controls pointers are stored to `vecControls`
when a python addon execute `self.removeControl` in a XML window
the `Window::doRemoveControl` is executed
but the while loop to `vecControls` delete the specified control pointer
the pointer data is so lost and the `SendGUIMessage` that is executed after that send a dead pointer that make kodi crash
so solution is just reverse the code order

Now I don't know why this works with some release build, perhaps the code execution it is so fast in the that the pointer data has not yet been completely wiped from memory, however this on debug builds always make kodi crashes
differently on android also the release build make kodi crash

## Motivation and context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
<!--- If it fixes an open issue, please link to the issue here. -->
fix #22674
## How has this been tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your change. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->
Used python test addon in the Issue
the test addon is a bit confusing but the relevant file is in the file:
resources/lib/kodi/ui/xmldialog_ratingthumb.py
on `onInit` method the first `self.removeControl`  call cause kodi crash

tested on windows debug build and android release build (on android debug and release was crashing)

## What is the effect on users?
<!--- Summarize the effect of this change on Kodi end-users. -->
<!--- If the PR does not have a noticeable impact (e.g., if it only changes documentation), -->
<!--- just leave it empty. Put in more detail the bigger the impact is. -->
<!--- This section may be used for automatic creation of release notes. -->
Python addons that use custom XML windows and `self.removeControl` dont make crash kodi anymore

<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->

## Bug report
### Describe the bug
Here is a clear and concise description of what the problem is:
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
I have a custom window by using `xbmcgui.WindowXMLDialog`
on `onInit()` method i placed the code to remove some added XML button controls

look at sample addon on file: `resources/lib/kodi/ui/xmldialog_ratingthumb.py`
relative window xml: `resources/skins/default/1080i/plugin-video-netflix-RatingThumb.xml`

so the window is opened correctly but when it execute `self.removeControl` kodi crashes

~_seem a problem of current master branch_~
~on Kodi 19 or 20 i dont have crashes, maybe by luck?~

if you use Windows nightly release, the crash never happens
if you self build kodi for Windows, as debug mode, the crash always happens
on android its weird, usually can happens the first time, on next kodi run seem dont crash anymore


## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Have the window opened with the controls removed

## Actual Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The window is opened but kodi crashes


## Possible Fix
<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix or reason for the bug -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
I tried investigate and i see something weird on control pointers
on: https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/master/xbmc/interfaces/legacy/Window.cpp#L553-L566

when the `while` is executed the control is erased from vecControls vector
after that `pControl` become with weird content at least my debugger show weird values
and when is executed the SendGUIMessage, callback fall here:
https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/master/xbmc/guilib/GUIWindow.cpp#L698
on mentioned line the dereference make kodi to crash

no idea for a good fix

### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
1. Build kodi as debug mode for Windows
2. Install: [plugin.video.netflix_1.20.5+matrix.1_TEST.zip](https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/files/10569485/plugin.video.netflix_1.20.5%2Bmatrix.1_TEST.zip) its a modded fake addon, just to open the custom window dialog
3. Run the addon
4. A small window dialog with thumb up / down should be shown without Kodi crash
